correctness.rationale: The graph-state cross-cut amplitude matrix has phase (-1)^(a^T C b), and tracing out the other side yields all-ones blocks indexed by ker C^T: exactly 2^r eigenvalues 2^-r for r=rank_F2 C. Across a coordinate cut, C is the third-distance convolution on F2^(d-1). The group algebra is R=F2[x_i]/(x_i^2), and its adjacency element A_n=binom(n,3)+binom(n-1,2)e1+(n-2)e2+e3 with e3=e1e2, reducing modulo four to e1(1+e2), e2(1+e1), e1e2 or (1+e1)(1+e2). Positive-degree 1+e_i factors are units. Multiplication by e1 has rank 2^(n-1); e2 has symplectic 2-form normal form and square-zero Künneth homology of dimension 2^m (times two for odd n), giving stated ranks. When n=2 mod4, simultaneously normalize e1 and e2 to u1 and sum u_i v_i, so e1e2 reduces to a tensor-product rank. Independent binary Gaussian elimination directly checked distance-three convolution ranks for n=3..10, yielding d4..11 entropies 8,8,12,12,128,128,240,240. Finite ranks corroborate, rather than prove, general formulas. Scope is pure qubit state and one-coordinate half cuts, not arbitrary bipartitions.
